The main takeaway from our work is that
the size distribution of airborne particulates and their associated heavy metals is a function of both the source and the local meteorological conditions.
the size distributions of PM and heavy metals in the inhalable fraction are not uniform and that they vary significantly with particle size.

PM size distributions and heavy metals are not only influenced by traffic, but also by other local anthropogenic and/or natural sources, and that the use of PM size distributions and metal concentrations for source apportionment should be interpreted with caution.
